notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary directed-interaction fan-out. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies that two active universal subscribers each receive two directed interactions addressed to the same registered target in producer send order, that the sender is excluded, and that target identity, interaction class, parameter value, user tag, producing federate, and transportation metadata are preserved. Timestamped delivery, by-ownership subscription, regions/DDM, custom transportation, MOM, save/restore, and provider-private behavior remain outside this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object/interaction lookup, object publication, universal directed-interaction publication and subscription, object registration, ordinary targeted Send Directed Interaction, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, destruction, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery and Receive Directed Interaction callbacks
